# btpservice_ctms_route (Data Source)

Reads a CTMS route by decimal ID or exact name. Configure exactly one selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "btpservice_ctms_route" "example" {
  name = "DEVELOPMENT_TO_QUALITY"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Decimal route ID. Configure exactly one of id or name.
- `name` (String) Exact route name. Configure exactly one of id or name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Route description returned by CTMS.
- `source_node_id` (String) Decimal source node ID. A source can have multiple outgoing routes.
- `target_node_id` (String) Decimal target node ID. A node can be the target of only one route.
